subject: words
title: Ea words
about: Another way to spell long e: ea, as in eat and beach, all words where ea says ee (ea can also say short e, as in bread, but none of those are here). CKLA Grade 1 teaches only ee for this sound (Unit 2) and leaves ea to Grade 2, so this is a step-ahead level for the spring once Ee words are solid; NC RF.1.4.c (vowel teams for long vowel sounds).
tip: Same sound as ee, new letters: have him name the team first, then read the word.
